scope: Compiled application in Chromium with in-memory store; not IndexedDB or deployment certification

checks.name: Shared top-left controls and paired rail order; new readers hidden by default
Bookmarks edit title, note and subject; lists are shared rather than workspace-scoped
Safe pasted URLs, no automatic fetch, read status, subject filtering and confirmed removal
PDF tree is only category and short page headings, with repeated page references
Physical PDF page actions preserve source and open a tab, second pane or numbered workspace
Queue can distinguish whole PDFs, physical pages and PDF categories; bookmarks separate
Full pane refuses a sixth tab without losing or replacing existing work
Separate Workspace States and document Context; checkpoint restore retains newer queue
Page context menu and subject tabs are keyboard-operable
Manager and paired actions fit desktop and phone without viewport overflow
